candidate.title: eCLIP
candidate.scope: Schematic-level eCLIP (enhanced crosslinking and immunoprecipitation) architecture: the middle horizontal row of the attached Illumina crop, from RNA-protein complex through UV/lysis, RNase I digestion, immunoprecipitation, on-complex 3′ RNA-adapter addition, protein removal/RNA extraction, and the broad cDNA-generation block to terminal cDNA. The assigned card title and the verified catalogue page identify eCLIP. The complete crop was inspected: the upper miR-CLIP row has its own capture-probe/psoralen/Ago2/streptavidin route, and the lower irCLIP row has its own IR800-biotin adapter/circularization route; they are separately labelled neighbouring assay rows, not alternatives or branches of eCLIP. The clipped Pol II row at the top and chemistry panel at the right likewise do not enter this route. No branch or pooling is depicted within eCLIP. The primary Van Nostrand implementation resolves the post-RT adapter ambiguity without adding its unshown control branches, purification substeps, amplification or sequencing as graph operations.

operations.label: UV 254 nm crosslink lyse and fragment
operations.description: Irradiation stabilizes the starting RNA-protein association, and lysis releases crosslinked complexes into lysate. The caption groups crosslinking, lysis and fragmentation; the following RNase I drawing makes the RNA-shortening operation explicit.
operations.mechanism: UV-induced covalent RNA-protein crosslinking, followed by lysis; RNase I fragmentation is retained as the next local operation.
operations.information_effect: Fixes a subset of RNA-protein contacts before isolation. The target is RBP-associated RNA; crosslink recovery does not cover all RNA-binding domains according to the catalogue limitations.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: The diagram places P5, P7 and Random oligo on a broad RNA-to-cDNA block and ends at cDNA. Primary-paper resolution: first RNA is reverse-transcribed; a separate ssDNA adapter is then ligated to the new cDNA 3′ end. Those two transformations are represented together at the resolution of this depicted block, with their order explicit.
operations.mechanism: RNA-templated DNA synthesis, then post-RT ssDNA adapter ligation to cDNA. The random-mer belongs to that second adapter; the drawing alone does not establish random-primed RT or the exact installation of full P5/P7 handles.
operations.information_effect: DNA sequence encodes the immunoprecipitated RNA fragment; RT truncation can locate a crosslink. The inline random-mer helps distinguish identical-sequence original molecules from PCR duplicates. In the paper, read 1 starts with the RNA-adapter barcode and read 2 starts with the random-mer followed by the crosslink-proximal RNA-fragment end. Sequencing, PCR and control normalization are outside the drawn route.
